artworks.title: Le reveil
artworks.artist: Pierre Charles Levesque after François Boucher
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a woman lying on her stomach on a bed made of soft cushions and draped in fabric. She is propped up on her elbows, with her chin resting on her hands, looking outside the frame. She has a slight smile and her hair is styled in an updo. There is a small table next to her with a decorative urn or teapot and a ribbon on top. The background features a textured wall with panels and drapery.

artworks.title: L'Amant surpris
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Jean Frederic Schall
artworks.medium: color etching and engraving on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two people in a park. One person is standing, covering the eyes of the seated individual. The standing person has curly brown hair, a hat with a red ribbon, and wears a light-colored dress with a brown sash. The seated person wears a red vest, a blue coat, and beige trousers. The seated person is smiling and leaning back. The setting includes lush greenery, trees, flowering bushes, a large potted plant on a stone pedestal, and a stone cherub statue. Papers are scattered on the ground.

artworks.title: The Upset Basket
artworks.artist: C.-A.-L. Buisson after Charles Michel-Ange Challe
artworks.medium: stipple engraving
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated on a stone bench. The person on the left leans towards the other, with one arm around their back, while the person on the right leans back slightly against them. The left person has curly, shoulder-length hair. The right person has hair styled up with curls framing their face, which is turned slightly away from the viewer. The individuals wear clothing reminiscent of historical, possibly 18th-century fashion, long dresses with voluminous skirts and fitted bodices. Around them, there is a large decorative urn on a stone plinth to the left, partially surrounded by leafy foliage. A basket with an array of fruits is on the ground to the right. In the background, dense foliage with a hint of a sculpted bust or statue partially obscured by leaves adds to the classical setting. The scene is rendered in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Mademoiselle Contat
artworks.medium: color stipple engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile portrait of a woman, featuring her upper body. She is positioned in profile facing to the left with her head held high. The woman's facial features include a delicate nose, full lips, and finely arched eyebrows. Her hair is styled with voluminous curls and an ornate headdress adorned with bows and feathers. She is wearing a garment with a low, lace-lined neckline and a decorative bouquet of flowers pinned on her chest. The background is a soft, muted tone inside an oval frame with pastel colors and a brushed texture.

artworks.title: Mademoiselle Olivier
artworks.medium: color stipple engraving
artworks.description: The image is a portrait depicting a person from the waist up, in profile facing right. They have fair skin with flushed cheeks, delicate facial features, and elegant hair adorned with a voluminous hat featuring intricate designs. They are dressed in a blue outfit with a high-collar, lace details on the sleeves. The oval frame is set against a light orange and cream marbled background. The subject is set within a dark oval background, creating contrast.

artworks.title: Mademoiselle Maillard
artworks.medium: color stipple engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman. She is in profile, facing left. Her facial features are delicate with rounded cheeks. She has light-colored hair styled in waves and curls, and it is adorned with a veil. She wears a richly colored garment with floral designs on the sleeves. The background is plain with an oval frame.

artworks.title: Mme. de M ... en habit de bal
artworks.artist: Pierre Louis de Surugue after Charles-Antoine Coypel
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman displayed from the waist up as she sits in a chair. Her body is angled slightly to the side with her head turned toward the viewer. She has a delicate facial structure with her eyes looking directly outward, a subtle smile, and her hair styled in an elaborate updo adorned with a bow. The woman is dressed in an ornate gown featuring intricate patterns and decorations, such as bows and tassels. She holds a small mask in her left hand. Around her neck is a choker, and she wears earrings. The chair she sits in is upholstered and decorated with elegant carvings. In the background, there is a classical architectural element, such as a column, and the area is shaded with vertical lines.

artworks.title: Mme. de M ... en habit de bal
artworks.artist: Pierre Louis de Surugue after Charles-Antoine Coypel
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a chair from the waist up. She is turned slightly to her right, facing the viewer with a composed expression. She has a gentle smile, large eyes, and styled hair adorned with flowers, pearls, and ribbons. She wears an opulent gown with lace and ribbon details, tassels, delicate gloves, and holds a fan. Accessories include a choker with a pendant, elaborate earrings, and the background features a column, suggesting a grand interior.

artworks.title: Les cerises
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper (proof)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person picking or handling grapes from a basket in front of them. The person is looking over their left shoulder towards the viewer. They have delicate facial features with soft, rounded cheeks and an attentive gaze. The person's hair is styled in an updo with a few curls hanging down. They are wearing a loose-fitting blouse with sleeves gathered at the elbows, typical of an 18th-century style. A pair of scissors is on the table, and a piece of cloth is beneath the basket of grapes. In the background, there is an oval frame adorned with intricate botanical designs, including a garland of flowers and leaves, as well as classical motifs at the bottom of the frame.

artworks.title: Les prunes
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image features a woman seated upright, from the waist up. She has a serene expression with prominent eyes and delicate features. Her hair is styled upwards and adorned with a decorative headpiece blending with the curls. She wears a period-style dress with ruffled sleeves and a low neckline. She is surrounded by various fruits on the fabric. In her right hand, she holds a small floral object, possibly a flower. The setting includes an oval frame with floral and foliage motifs, adding an ornate touch. The background within the frame is plain, emphasizing the woman and her surroundings.

artworks.title: Annette et Lubin
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (with framing line): 27 × 23 cm (10 5/8 × 9 1/16 in.)
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 39.4 × 29.4 cm (15 1/2 × 11 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals outdoors in a pastoral setting.

artworks.title: Le Compliment ou La Matinée du jour de l'an (The Compliment or New Year's Morning)
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (with framing line): 30 × 25.1 cm (11 13/16 × 9 7/8 in.)
sheet (trimmed at or just within platemark): 36.7 × 28.6 cm (14 7/16 × 11 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in an indoor setting. On the left, an older man is seated in a chair, leaning forward with an open smile. Opposite him, an older woman is seated, smiling gently. Beside her stands a middle-aged man with curly hair and a decorative hat. A young girl in a brown dress and a young boy in a light-colored outfit stand beside them. The young boy is engaging with the seated man. Behind them, a man in a dark military-style coat stands next to a table with various objects. The room has paintings and a clock mounted on the walls, suggesting a formal and elegant ambiance of the late 18th century.

artworks.title: Les Bouquets, ou la Fête de la Grand-Maman
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a classic setting. Five individuals, including children and adults, are gathered around an elderly woman seated in a chair. The elderly woman wears a bonnet and a white dress with ruffles, holding a child in a light-colored outfit with a blue bow. A young boy in a striped suit and hat presents a bouquet or gift to the seated woman. An older man in a blue suit interacts with the children, and another man in a dark suit stands behind him. A woman in a black and white dress with a blue sash stands close to the chair, holding a bouquet. On the right, a woman in a white gown and blue ribbon looks on. The room is elegantly furnished, with a wooden cabinet and flowers on a table. The color scheme is soft with muted blues, greys, and whites.

artworks.title: Les Deux Baisers (The Two Kisses)
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (including framing line): 27.6 × 36.9 cm (10 7/8 × 14 1/2 in.)
sheet (trimmed to platemark): 36.3 × 42.5 cm (14 5/16 × 16 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three adults sitting together. The man on the left is dressed in 18th-century attire with a white wig, holding a small dog on his lap. The woman in the center is wearing a white gown with floral decorations on her head. The man on the right is holding a palette and paintbrushes, dressed in a brown suit coat. The background includes a large painting, an artist's easel, a guitar, a bust, and a bookcase. There are draped curtains, tall windows, and a wooden floor.

artworks.title: Mgr. Le duc d'Orléans
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.description: The image includes a bust portrait of a man centered within a decorative circular frame. The man is facing slightly to his right with a neutral expression. He has a round face, prominent nose, full lips, light complexion, and grey, short wavy hair styled off his forehead. He wears a red coat with a ribbon, a star-shaped medal, and intricate gold embroidery on the collar. There is a white lace cravat around his neck. The circular frame is embellished with an ornate stone motif featuring laurels at the top and a relief sculpture at the bottom with various figures, including a shield and open books. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Heur et Malheur, ou la Cruche cassée
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a pastoral scene near a fountain. The image shows a tranquil setting with a fountain pouring water into a calm stream or pond. Various elements of nature and human life are present around the fountain, including lush greenery, tall trees forming a canopy in the background, plants with vibrant flowers, a small animal by the fountain, and haystacks or a pile of straw. Dispersed clothing items suggest that someone may have been present. The painting is in the style of Jean-Baptiste Greuze.

artworks.title: L'Escalade, ou les Adieux du Matin
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 30.4 × 24.8 cm (11 15/16 × 9 3/4 in.)
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 34.6 × 25.3 cm (13 5/8 × 9 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two people outdoors. The man has one foot on the ground and the other on a stone structure, leaning towards the woman. The woman is standing beside him, facing slightly towards him, and holding a small bundle. Both have wavy hair. The man wears a wide-brimmed hat, a white shirt, blue trousers, and a blue coat draped over one shoulder. The woman wears a white gown with an apron tied around her waist. They are both barefoot. A dog is beside the woman, and a rooster is near the stone steps to the right. In the background, there is a thatched cottage, stone walls, and dense, overhanging trees.

artworks.title: La Rose
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals depicted from head to ankle, with one kneeling and one seated. The man on the left is kneeling on one knee and turning slightly towards the seated woman, offering her a rose with one hand while looking at her. He has a youthful face, clean-shaven, and is wearing a powdered wig typical of the fashion at the time. He is dressed in a formal suit with a blue coat, yellow breeches, and knee-high white socks. The woman is seated on a bench, holding onto the rose he is offering, and gazes downwards towards it. Her hair is styled with curls and adorned with a blue ribbon. She is wearing a voluminous dress in white and light blue with a pink sash and draped in a dark shawl. A closed book and a handkerchief rest on the bench beside her. Both figures are surrounded by a lush garden setting with a statue of a cherub behind them. The background features dense foliage with hints of a forest and a waterfall in the distance.

artworks.title: La Main
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 23.9 × 18.9 cm (9 7/16 × 7 7/16 in.)
sheet (trimmed to platemark): 36.1 × 25.7 cm (14 3/16 × 10 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a garden scene with classical architecture and sculptures. The painting displays a lush garden enclosed by deciduous trees and shrubbery, with an elegant stone archway in the background. Ornate attire featuring voluminous dresses, lace, and formal coats adorn the figures. A classic sculpture stands to the left among neatly placed hedges, while a decorative balustrade to the right leads into an unseen area. An overturned flower pot lies on the ground, adding to the lively activity. The style is reminiscent of Jean-Honoré Fragonard.

artworks.title: Le Menuet de la mariee (The Bride's Minuet)
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.description: The painting depicts an outdoor gathering scene with figures engaged in conversation, dancing, and various activities typical of a festive event. The central focus is a group of people in elaborate period costumes, with others around them in different postures. There is a makeshift dwelling or pavilion draped with fabric in the background. Trees and a cloudy sky complete the setting. This artwork is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson, known for his detailed depiction of English social life in the 18th century.

artworks.title: La Noce au Chateau
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting an outdoor gathering in a park with trees and tents. The scene shows elegantly dressed figures interacting amidst lush greenery and a peaceful blue sky. The central focus is a group of figures in formal attire, with elaborate clothing and hats. Tents in the background suggest a festivity, with figures sitting, talking, or engaging in activities. The overall mood is lively and communal, capturing a moment of leisure and social engagement in a natural setting. The style is reminiscent of Thomas Rowlandson, known for satirical depictions of societal scenes in 18th century England.

artworks.title: L'Oiseau ranime
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner
artworks.description: The image features two women standing side by side. The woman on the left has curly brown hair with a blue ribbon and is wearing a white dress. The woman on the right has curly brown hair with a white cap adorned with flowers and is holding a bird. The room they are in is elaborately decorated with blue curtains and wooden paneling.

artworks.title: The Palais Royal - Gallery's Walk / Promenade de la Galerie du Palais Royal
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 29.2 x 55.9 cm (11 1/2 x 22 in.)
sheet (trimmed at or within platemark): 36.5 x 57.1 cm (14 3/8 x 22 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This print depicts a crowded interior space filled with elegantly dressed people. The people wear elaborate attire, including wide-brimmed hats and flowing robes and gowns accentuated with feathers and lace. The people all appear to have pale skin and hair in shades of white and gray set in elaborate, curled styles. Some of the people have slightly exaggerated proportions, making them look cartoonish. The setting is a grand hall with arched windows featuring blue lattice designs and decorative orange curtains, and detailed architectural elements such as columns and high ceilings are visible in the background. Surrounding the print is a border of off-white paper, with a line of text at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Palais Royal--Garden's Walk / Promenade du Jardin du Palais Royal
artworks.artist: Louis Le Coeur after Claude-Louis Desrais
artworks.medium: wash manner with etching and engraving, printed in blue, red, yellow, and black inks
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 37.7 x 56.5 cm (14 13/16 x 22 1/4 in.)
overall (inner framing line): 27.9 x 53.9 cm (11 x 21 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a gathering in a garden with striped tents and large trees providing shade. The architecture in the background suggests an urban setting. The people in the painting are dressed in elaborate, colorful attire. The style is reminiscent of Jean-Honoré Fragonard, known for lively scenes and intricate compositions of the Rococo period.
